content.title: Welcome to ANQL
content.description: ANQL is a powerful visual document editor that allows you to create and organize your ideas intuitively.

content.title: Node creation on autocomplete
description: Type the node name directly then press TAB to confirm.
Available node types:
- Code: Insert code blocks with syntax highlighting
- Line: Add horizontal separators
- Image: Insert images from URLs or files
- Table: Create structured tables
- Heading 1: Main section headings
- Heading 2: Subsection headings
- Heading 3: Minor headings
- Number List: Ordered numbered lists
- Bullet List: Unordered bullet lists
- Check List: Todo/task lists with checkboxes
- Quote: Block quotes for citations
- Math: Mathematical operation and conversion
- Help: Access to this documentation

content.title: Node Creation by using menu
description: Create a new node to start building your document.
Click on the creation button to access the menu.
Choose from the available options.

content.title: Node Menu
description: Each node has its own options menu to modify its properties and content.
Access the menu by clicking on the node handle or using keyboard shortcuts.
The menu provides various actions for manipulating and transforming nodes.

content.title: Transform Node Type
description: You can transform nodes into other node types.
Transformation Rules:
Only certain node types can be transformed
Transformable types: paragraph, heading, quote, code, list, listitem
Non-transformable types: image, table, math, line
All selected nodes must be transformable for the menu to appear
Available transformations:
- Normal: Convert to paragraph (Ctrl+Alt+0 / Mac: ⌘⌥0)
- Heading 1: Convert to main heading (Ctrl+Alt+1 / Mac: ⌘⌥1)
- Heading 2: Convert to sub heading (Ctrl+Alt+2 / Mac: ⌘⌥2)
- Heading 3: Convert to minor heading (Ctrl+Alt+3 / Mac: ⌘⌥3)
- Number List: Convert to numbered list (Ctrl+Shift+7 / Mac: ⌘⇧7)
- Bullet List: Convert to bullet list (Ctrl+Shift+8 / Mac: ⌘⇧8)
- Check List: Convert to todo list (Ctrl+Shift+9 / Mac: ⌘⇧9)
- Quote: Convert to block quote (Ctrl+Shift+. / Mac: ⌘⇧.)
- Code: Convert to code block (Ctrl+Alt+C / Mac: ⌘⌥C)
